worldcombat.skill.spiritbreak.summary: Step in with a heavy palm. Its short forward window can break one hostile projectile that native interception allows. The first body contacted takes the original strike, Special Attack reduction and native shove; unsupported special shots continue normally.
worldcombat.skill.spiritbreak.use.0: Pin a special attacker in place
worldcombat.skill.spiritbreak.use.1: Knock a foe out of formation and break its Sp. Atk
worldcombat.skill.spiritbreak.use.2: Meet one interceptable shot before delivering the palm
worldcombat.skill.spiritbreak.descriptio: Step along your aim and strike the first enemy body contacted for about %1$s physical power.
On hit the target's Sp. Atk falls %1$s stage(s).

Use half of the original %1$s-block momentum budget at %2$s blocks per tick, then a close palm. A landed strike applies up to %3$s blocks of native received push; minimum body-sweep half-width %4$s blocks. The palm can legally intercept only one shot.
worldcombat.skill.spiritbreak.shatter.on: Currently the shatter form: a harder hit, 2 stages of Sp. Atk loss and a longer shove, but a shorter charge with a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.spiritbreak.shatter.of: Currently the quick charge: 1 stage of Sp. Atk loss, further reach and a faster cast.
worldcombat.skill.spiritbreak.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.spiritbreak.growth.0: From level %1$s the charge rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.spiritbreak.growth.1: From level %1$s the charge rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.spiritbreak.preference: On: charge ×1.15, 2 stages of Sp. Atk loss, a longer shove, but a shorter charge, +2 ticks wind-up and +8 ticks cooldown. Off: the quick charge, 1 stage of loss, further reach and a faster cast.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values make it open the charge from further away.
